spec_match.rationale: Models the documented pipeline (HttpsUpgrades attempt with 3s/5s fallback params from chrome_features.cc, Balanced exemptions, HttpsOnlyMode policy states, HttpAllowlist) and repeatedly labels the interstitial step as illustration because the real UI is pre-navigation browser chrome.

interactive.rationale: URL input, server-behaviour, mode and allowlist selects rebuild the step list live; a real host classifier (loopback / private IPv4 ranges / single-label / .local) runs on every keystroke; Next/Back/Restart step the flow.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index bills it as a step-through with a real exemption classifier and a labelled illustrative interstitial — exactly what renders.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers already-https, policy-off, upgrade-success, http-only, bad-cert, allowlisted, balanced-exempt, and strict-mode branches, each with its own outcome text.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5143933628841984, HttpsOnlyMode policy, and the Chromium blog post.

conformance.rationale: The interstitial and policy contracts appear in the feature suite as manual assertions with exact verification steps, matching this page's honest framing.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP matrix on both classes with autorun stepping to the final interstitial+outcome state; screenshots read (dark current-step card, rose outcome, classifier line correct for example.com); zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on every rebuild that a step list or outcome was produced.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; the current step inverts to black with an explicit ivory rule for its detail text; done/skipped states keep AA contrast.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled selects and input, aria-current=step on the active step, aria-live outcome, disabled state management on Next/Back, list semantics for the flow.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: auto-fit form grid collapses to one column at 360; steps are full-width cards; CDP reports no overflow on either class.

openQuestions.title: Cross-check the Balanced-mode exemption list against shipping Chrome 154
openQuestions.detail: The classifier mirrors chrome_features.cc comments and the HttpsFirstBalancedMode description (loopback, single-label, private IPs, .local, allowlist). Chrome may also exempt sites with prior http engagement in the shipped heuristics; when a real Chrome 154 build is available, walk an http-only engaged site and refine the classifier copy if its behaviour differs.

guidanceConsulted.query: multi step interactive walkthrough state machine accessible buttons
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons for step controls, expose the current step programmatically, and avoid conveying progress by colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native Next/Back/Restart buttons with disabled management, aria-current='step' on the active li, step numbers and text in the DOM, aria-live outcome line.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: auto-fit minmax grids for form layouts; full-width block cards for sequential content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Setup grid uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px,1fr)); the flow is a single-column card list that needs no breakpoint.

summary: Illustrative-but-honest walkthrough: real classifier logic, real policy vocabulary, clearly labelled fake interstitial. Verified on both classes via CDP with the autorun path ending at the ask.
